'''Ultraviolet sensors'''<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> or '''UV sensors''' measured [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] light. [[Radiation zone assault trooper]]s had UV sensors built into the [[Macrobinocular viewplate/Legends|macrobinocular viewplate]] of their [[Radiation zone assault trooper armor|armor]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> [[DZ-70 fugitive tracker droid]]s were equipped with ultraviolet sensors.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
